text: Binary per-row flag from the "argument" column (OP's own text only, current supplied text including marked edits): 1 if the OP, in their own voice, uses at least one explicit marker of uncertainty about their own claims or view (e.g., "I might be wrong", "I'm not sure", "maybe", "possibly", "to my knowledge", "I think" used as a hedge, stated doubt); 0 if the argument is assessable and has no such marker. Does not count uncertainty in quoted external text or attributed to others, rhetorical questions that aren't the OP's own doubt, or moderator/bot notices. Ignores/excludes OP view-change or delta-award announcements, post-outcome thank-you/resolution updates, and any text reporting whether the view changed (even inside the argument); generic discussion of delta/platform rules is not outcome text and may count. No reconstruction of an initial version and edits are kept except outcome-reporting text. Returns null if the argument is missing or malformed.
